sloka: एतस्य सा मतिः सर्वा यद्दृष्टा जनकात्मजा ।हनूमता वेगवता राघवस्य हितैषिणा ॥६-२६-१९॥।।
transliteration: etasya sā matiḥ sarvā yaddṛṣṭā janakātmajā ।hanūmatā vegavatā rāghavasya hitaiṣiṇā ॥6-26-19॥।।

translations.english: "He is a well wisher of Raghava, called Hanuman. He had come to see Janaka's daughter, and his intellect is the cause for all that."
